notes.title: Patch Update 0.7.3
notes.content: [p]We've made a few small changes after launch, the demo should be a much smoother experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Player slide double jump glitch[/p][/*][*][p]Punch radius bug[/p][/*][*][p]R was mistaken for a reload a few times, the new button is P (this can be changed through rebindings)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies sometimes not knocked down when too close[/p][/*][*][p]Stealing weapons off of enemies who weren't downed[/p][/*][*][p]Some tiny tweaks to sewer_02, sewer_03 and subway_01[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper shot time decreased[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has played and given us this feedback. And to anyone who enjoys the demo, PLEASE wishlist and leave a review. Steam gives games more visibility after 10 reviews so if you could, we would greatly appreciate it![/p]

tags.bug: - R was mistaken for a reload a few times, the new button is P (this can be changed through rebindings)
- Enemies sometimes not knocked down when too close
- Stealing weapons off of enemies who weren't downed
- Some tiny tweaks to sewer_02, sewer_03 and subway_01
